content:
The upper half of the disk has angle \(180^\circ\). On the right side, the blue radius is \(25^\circ+45^\circ=70^\circ\) above \(OB\). On the left side, the other boundary is \(40^\circ\) above \(OA\). Thus the shaded sector has central angle

\[
180^\circ-70^\circ-40^\circ=70^\circ.
\]

For a uniformly chosen point in the disk, the probability is proportional to the sector’s area, so it is the ratio of the central angle to \(360^\circ\):

\[
\frac{70^\circ}{360^\circ}=\frac{7}{36}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{7}{36}}
\]
